description: This PHP source file defines the ParserModifyListView class, which extends ModuleBuilderParser. It manages the loading, editing, and saving of list view definitions for a module within the SuiteCRM platform. The class includes methods for initializing with module data, fetching default, available, and additional fields, validating fields, loading layout from requests, and handling save operations.

classes.name: ParserModifyListView
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing, editing, and saving list view definitions for modules in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the parser with module-specific data, including loading original and custom list view definitions from files.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language module name associated with this parser.

methods.name: fixKeys
methods.description: Re-keys an array to ensure each element has a lowercase 'name' key and uses the name as key, simplifying further handling.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns default fields for list view, filtering out fields marked as non-default and managing reserved fields.

methods.name: getAdditionalFields
methods.description: Returns fields available for users to add as additional fields to the list view.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns a list of unused fields that can be added to the list view.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Determines if a field is valid for inclusion based on visibility, type, source, and naming conventions.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a specific field by name.

methods.name: addRelateData
methods.description: Enhances relate fields with module and link information for list view display.

methods.name: _loadLayoutFromRequest
methods.description: Loads list view layout configuration from POST/REQUEST data.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Handles saving of the modified list view layout to file and clears relevant cache for immediate updating.
